'''Old Ord Mantell City''' was a ruined [[city]] on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. It was located on the far side of the planet from [[Ord Mantell City]]. At the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]], a group of [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s led by [[Raney]] holed up in the ruins with several captives and [[Muchi]], a stolen [[rancor]] belonging to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] recruited the fugitive [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|retrieve]] the rancor when they came to her for information, resulting in a skirmish in the ruins.

==Description==
Old Ord Mantell City<ref name="DB">{{Databank|old-ord-mantell-city|Old Ord Mantell City}}</ref> was a [[city]] on [[Ord Mantell]], situated on the far side of the [[planet]] from [[Ord Mantell City]]. Located in a [[mountain]] valley, the city had an extensive array of buildings, including at least one plaza with fountains,<ref name="Rampage" /> fortresses, and various beautiful edifices.<ref name="DB" /> All of it had been reduced to ruins by the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Rampage" />

==History==
Old Ord Mantell City was constructed on Ord Mantell<ref name="Rampage" /> sometime prior to the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> By the beginning of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] Era in that year,<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the city had been reduced to ruins, with its population gone. At that [[time]], a group of [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s led by [[Raney]] holed up in the ruins with several [[Slavery|enslaved]] individuals and [[Muchi]], a young [[rancor]] stolen from the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Rampage" />

Jabba's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], hired the [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], who was based in Ord Mantell City, to retrieve Muchi. In turn, Scaleback recruited the fugitive [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]],<ref name="Rampage" /> a group of [[clone commando]]s who had defected from the Empire,<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> to carry out the job when they came to her for information. The Batch travelled to the ruins and scouted them out, noting the square where the enslavers were encamped with their captives.<ref name="Rampage" />
